closingNote: Closed slow — we led objectives but the game ran 35 minutes. Convert Fangtooth/tower leads into ending the game, don't farm the lead and risk a throw.
draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane).

coaching.headline: Three favored lanes (carry, offlane, jungle) and a fed Sparrow carried it, but we let a 35-minute game stay close on bad trades.
coaching.team: The draft was strongly ours — carry, offlane and jungle all favored, and Sparrow turned it into 13 kills and 53k hero damage. We owned objectives (78k damage to 17k, 23 objective kills to 15). What kept it from being a clean win was a run of bad trades in the open: 0-2 at 8 min, 0-2 at 24.8, and the worst, a 4-man 0-4 at 27.8 with no objective up. We finally grouped properly — the 32.7 Orb Prime fight (2-0) and the 34.2 open-map ace (4-0) ended it. The closing note is right: convert Fangtooth and tower leads into ending the game instead of farming the lead and risking a throw. After 19 min we held every major; that should have closed sooner.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: A fed Sparrow (13 kills, 53k damage) plus winning the Orb Prime fight at 32.7 and the 34.2 ace — after bleeding bodies in open-map bad trades that dragged the game to 35 min.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Riktor was excellent — 17 assists, only 2 deaths, and big mitigation as the frontline. Mr_Meat31 set up the won fights at 12.2 and 34.2. The one fix is the open-map fight at 27.8 (0-4): a full 5v5 started with our mid pinned across the map and no major up. As the engage, that's the fight to wave off and ward instead.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Steel was favored into Sevarog and Goldilocks324 locked the offlane (47k mitigated, 2 deaths). Goldilocks324 showed up for the close — the 32.7 Orb Prime fight (2-0) was Steel's. Goldilocks324 ran no armor into a 3-physical comp per the flag; with the game already won that didn't bite, but it's the habit to fix.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: This was the carry game — 13 kills, 2 deaths, 53k hero damage, and 32k into objectives. Cuban Noobster's Sparrow was online from Vanquisher at 25 and closed the 34.2 ace. Nothing to fix in the play; the team just needed to group around Cuban sooner to end before 35.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Feng Mao was the favored jungle and Xeebs delivered — 27k hero damage, 25k to objectives, and Xeebs anchored the early map. Xeebs got caught in the 24.8 and 27.8 bad trades though (0-2, 0-4). With that lead, those were the moments to take a tower or vision instead of flipping a coin-toss in the open.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zinx was an unfavored lane (theirs all game vs Renna) and Willy Guggenheim still finished 6/3/9 — good adaptation. Willy was in the 32.7 close-out fight. At 27.8 Willy was pinned and losing lane, so the team opened that 5v5 a body short across the map — that's the team's read to fix; keep poking from range.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Greystone. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
enemyKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
enemyKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

loadout.name: Wanton Warden
loadout.text: Regenerate Health equal to 4-7% of damage taken over 5s. Increases with Hero Level.
loadout.plain: Heals back part of the damage you take over a few seconds. Riktor wants to soak damage after pulling a target with Riplash, so this keeps him standing in long fights.

loadout.name: Krix
loadout.text: Gain 5% (+1% per Level) increased Maximum Health, and bonus size equal to 0.5% of your Maximum Health.
loadout.plain: Generic tankiness: more max health and a slightly bigger body. Nothing specific to Riktor's abilities, but it helps him survive as the frontliner holding targets with Riplash and Skewer.

loadout.name: Regenerative Tissue
loadout.text: After 8s without taking Hero damage, regenerate 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health per second at Levels 1/6/11/16.

loadout.name: Cannibalism
loadout.text: Takedowns permanently increase your Maximum Health by 25.

loadout.name: Terminal Treatment
loadout.text: Refibrillator's On-Hit damage increases by 0-25%, based on Target's Missing Health.
loadout.plain: Your basic attack poison hits harder the lower the target's health is. Keep attacking a wounded enemy instead of switching targets to finish them.

loadout.name: Vesh
loadout.text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
numbers: 7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 21% by the end (35 min)
loadout.plain: Your ability damage on heroes leaves a burn afterward. Ricochet bouncing and Bad Medicine's two hits each add their own burn.

loadout.name: Lich
loadout.text: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.
loadout.plain: Your magical damage heals you, growing with level. Zinx's poison and abilities deal magical damage, so it adds sustain while poking.

loadout.name: Mind Rot
loadout.text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.
loadout.plain: The Vesh burn also takes a share of the target's current health, so it hurts most against healthy tanks hit by Ricochet.

loadout.name: Typhoon
loadout.text: Cyclone: On Successful Basic Attacks: Gain a stack of Cyclone On-Hit for 3s. Each stack increases your Attack Speed by 3 (+3%)%. Stacks up to 4 times. Mirage: When at 4 stacks of Cyclone: Dash a short distance. Mirages:
loadout.plain: Basic attacks build stacks of attack speed, and at full stacks you get a short dash. Lets Zinx keep her poison stacking while repositioning away from divers.

ultPlus: Ashbringer (Chrono Strikes): On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.• Only triggers once per ability.• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,106 hero damage a minute, more than 77% of Zinx mid players this patch (24% of the team's). The damage came from Prophecy, Orion, Cursed Ring.
Neural Regenesis at rank 3: 120s base, about 75.9s by the end (37% shorter) from 58 ability haste: Prophecy 15, Orion 15, Spectra 10, Ashbringer 10, Typhoon 8.

Ashbringer (Chrono Strikes): On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.• Only triggers once per ability.• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.
Zinx dealt 38,720 hero damage, 24% of their team's, with +220 magical power from items.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Cursed Ring (item): Increase your Total Attack Speed by 1.2x. Your Basic Attacks deal 25% less damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 21% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.
Terminal Treatment (augment): Refibrillator's On-Hit damage increases by 0-25%, based on Target's Missing Health.
Sustain: Lich: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.; 4,537 healing recorded.
Toughness: +100 health; took 27,090 damage, mitigated 16,907, died 3 times.

Loadout augment Terminal Treatment: Your basic attack poison hits harder the lower the target's health is. Keep attacking a wounded enemy instead of switching targets to finish them. (game text: Refibrillator's On-Hit damage increases by 0-25%, based on Target's Missing Health.) (changes Refibrillator) Field: 46.1% in 371 games, 98% of picks, level the hero-role's 46.6%.

Loadout Eternal Vesh: Your ability damage on heroes leaves a burn afterward. Ricochet bouncing and Bad Medicine's two hits each add their own burn. (game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 21% by the end (35 min)]

Loadout minor Mind Rot: The Vesh burn also takes a share of the target's current health, so it hurts most against healthy tanks hit by Ricochet. (game text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.)

(game text: Cyclone: On Successful Basic Attacks: Gain a stack of Cyclone On-Hit for 3s. Each stack increases your Attack Speed by 3 (+3%)%. Stacks up to 4 times. Mirage: When at 4 stacks of Cyclone: Dash a short distance. Mirages:) Field: 48.5% in 330 games, 87% of picks, above the hero-role's 46.6%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 7 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Orion, Spectra, Cursed Ring, Ashbringer, Typhoon, Terminal Treatment.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Vesh, Mind Rot. Zinx has 3 damaging abilities (Bad Medicine hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 58 ability haste brought them back 37% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot) sits on the same trigger as the items (every ability hit set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Zinx killed built magical armor (Sevarog). We killed Zinx 3 times.
Copy it? this 3-item core: 46.2% in 104 games, level with the 45.7% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
